title: TDP-43 regulates chromatin looping and gene transcription through binding and stabilizing DNA G-quadruplex structures
authors: Feng Yang; Suyang Zhang; Xiaofan Guo; Yulong Qiao; Yuwei Zhang; Hao Sun; Xiaona Chen; Huating Wang
one_liner_zh: 该文通过多组学整合分析揭示TDP-43通过结合并稳定DNA G-四链体调控染色质环和基因转录，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作研究，但缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，深度不足。
abstract: TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) is a multifunctional DNA/RNA-binding protein implicated in transcriptional and post-transcriptional regulation. Dysregulation of TDP-43 is closely correlated with human diseases such as cancer and neurodegenerative diseases. Although its roles in RNA metabolism are well characterized, its function in transcriptional regulation remains largely underexplored. DNA G-quadruplexes (dG4s) are non-canonical nucleic acid structures enriched at gene promoters and regulatory elements, where they facilitate chromatin looping and gene transcription. Here, we investigated the transcriptional regulatory role of TDP-43 by integrating multi-omics datasets, including Hi-C, dG4 ChIP-seq, TDP-43 ChIP-seq, RNA-seq and ATAC-seq from K562 and HepG2 cells. Our analyses demonstrate TDP-43 binding and dG4s formation are highly colocalized at chromatin loop anchors, particularly at promoter and enhancer regions. TDP-43 occupancy at these anchors correlates with increased dG4 stability, chromatin loop interaction frequency, elevated chromatin accessibility, and upregulated gene expression. Morover, TDP-43 knockdown in HepG2 cells revealed a significant reduction in dG4 formation and loop interaction strength, accompanied by widespread transcriptional dysregulation. Collectively, our findings highlight a novel regulatory role of TDP-43 in facilitating long-range chromatin interactions and transcriptional activation through binding to and stabilizing dG4 structures, providing a mechanistic basis for gene dysregulation driven by TDP-43 dysfunction in diseases.
abstract_zh: TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）是一种多功能DNA/RNA结合蛋白，参与转录和转录后调控。TDP-43的失调与人类疾病如癌症和神经退行性疾病密切相关。尽管其在RNA代谢中的作用已被充分表征，但其在转录调控中的功能仍 largely 未被探索。DNA G-四链体（dG4s）是非经典核酸结构，富集于基因启动子和调控元件处，促进染色质环化和基因转录。在此，我们通过整合多组学数据集，包括来自K562和HepG2细胞的Hi-C、dG4 ChIP-seq、TDP-43 ChIP-seq、RNA-seq和ATAC-seq，研究了TDP-43的转录调控作用。我们的分析表明，TDP-43结合和dG4形成在染色质环锚点处高度共定位，特别是在启动子和增强子区域。TDP-43在这些锚点的占据与dG4稳定性增加、染色质环相互作用频率升高、染色质可及性增强以及基因表达上调相关。此外，在HepG2细胞中敲低TDP-43揭示了dG4形成和环相互作用强度的显著降低，伴随广泛的转录失调。总体而言，我们的发现强调了TDP-43通过结合并稳定dG4结构促进长距离染色质相互作用和转录激活的新调控作用，为TDP-43功能障碍在疾病中导致的基因失调提供了机制基础。
